setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Press K2 in name entry. The Save project menu returns and neither named project file is created.
steps.title: Cancel the first save

steps.caption: Press K3 on Save project. The suggested name is new and OK is selected.
steps.title: Open name entry

steps.caption: Turn E2 left. DEL becomes bright and OK dims.
steps.title: Select DEL

steps.caption: Press K3 three times. The name is empty.
steps.title: Remove the suggested name

steps.caption: Turn E3 left to the character row, turn E2 to F, then press K3. F appears in the name.
steps.title: Enter F

steps.caption: Select and enter o, u, r, space, n, o, t, e and s with E2 and K3. The name reads Four notes.
steps.title: Complete Four notes

steps.caption: Turn E3 right, then E2 right. OK becomes bright with Four notes still visible.
steps.title: Select OK

steps.caption: Press and release K3, then K1. The arrangement returns on SLOT SETUP SONG01.
steps.title: Confirm the save

steps.caption: Open Load project and select Four notes.ptn, then cancel the picker and return to Mosaic. Both named files match the retained arrangement and no input remains held.
steps.title: Find the named project

title: Save the same arrangement under a name
